europe_now.title: Russian Missile Incident in Poland Raises Regional Security Concerns
europe_now.summary: Polish authorities report that a Russian cruise missile crossed the border, prompting heightened security measures and diplomatic discussions among Western allies. Prime Minister Donald Tusk noted that the incursion appears to be an intentional act amid wider escalation.

sources.headline: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk

europe_now.title: EU and UK Reach Landmark Agreement at Brussels Summit
europe_now.summary: European and British leaders have successfully concluded a major summit aimed at resetting bilateral relations. The newly announced framework addresses key areas including food standards, carbon markets, and youth mobility.
